summary: This bill requires states to allow 16-year-olds to pre-register to vote in federal elections, automatically registering them when they turn 18, and authorizes grants for states to encourage youth involvement in election activities.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes $25,000,000 in appropriations for grants to states to encourage the involvement of minors in election activities. This directly increases government spending.

The core purpose of this bill is to expand voting access by requiring states to implement pre-registration for 16-year-olds and providing grants to promote civic engagement among minors, which aims to increase future voter participation.
